name: Pomodoro Timer
description: Work in focused 25-minute intervals followed by short breaks. Scientifically proven to boost concentration and reduce mental fatigue.

name: Active Recall
description: Test yourself on the material instead of re-reading. Forces your brain to retrieve information, strengthening long-term memory.

name: Spaced Repetition
description: Review material at increasing intervals over time. Targets the forgetting curve to lock information into long-term memory.

name: Mind Mapping
description: Visually connect ideas around a central topic. Great for brainstorming, understanding complex subjects and organizing notes.

name: Feynman Technique
description: Explain a concept in simple terms as if teaching a child. If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.

name: Cornell Notes
description: Divide your page into cues, notes and summary sections. A structured system that makes review sessions faster and more effective.

name: Goal Tracker
description: Set short, medium and long-term goals. Break big goals into milestones and celebrate small wins to stay motivated.

name: Flashcard System
description: Create question-answer pairs for quick review. Combine with spaced repetition for maximum retention of facts, vocabulary and formulas.

name: Focus Music
description: Use lo-fi, binaural beats or white noise while studying. The right background sound can reduce distractions and improve flow state.

name: Daily Review Log
description: Spend 10 minutes at the end of each day reviewing what you learned. Reflection solidifies understanding and reveals gaps in knowledge.

name: Distraction Blocker
description: Block social media and distracting websites during study sessions. Remove temptation to maintain deep focus and protect your study time.

name: Study Streak
description: Track how many consecutive days you study. Streaks build powerful habits through the commitment to not break the chain.
